mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLACE WHERE PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM PLACE_REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo}
SELECT REVIEW_NO ,MEMBER_NO ,PLACE_NO ,DEL_YN FROM PLACE_REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT REVIEW_NO ,PLACE_NO ,MEMBER_NO ,RATING ,REVIEW_CONTENT ,TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM PLACE_REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE PLACE_REVIEW SET DEL_YN = 'Y' ,DELETE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT IMG_NO ,REVIEW_NO ,ORIGINAL_NAME ,SAVE_NAME ,IMG_PATH ,IMG_ORDER FROM REVIEW_IMG WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY IMG_ORDER ,IMG_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW_IMG SET DEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLACE_REVIEW WHERE PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1), 0.0) AS AVG_RATING ,COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_REVIEW_COUNT FROM PLACE_REVIEW WHERE PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT RATING ,COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM PLACE_REVIEW WHERE PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY RATING

SELECT R.REVIEW_NO ,R.MEMBER_NO ,M.MEMBER_NAME AS NICKNAME ,CASE WHEN M.SAVE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN M.IMG_PATH || M.SAVE_NAME ELSE NULL END AS PROFILE_IMG_PATH ,R.RATING ,R.REVIEW_CONTENT ,TO_CHAR(R.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM PLACE_REVIEW R JOIN WELLNESS_MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY R.CREATE_DATE DESC ,R.REVIEW_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
